updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Role Groups UI Enhancements
updates.summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal now enables admins to search and filter role group permissions by roles and memberships, improving visibility into access control configurations. This enhancement streamlines the process of auditing who has which permissions across the compliance environment.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot in Government Clouds
updates.summary: DLP protection for Copilot prompts now extends to government cloud environments, preventing sensitive data from being leaked through AI interactions. This capability ensures that Copilot will block responses and refuse to use sensitive data for grounding when policy conditions are triggered.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Block External Domain/User Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Admins can now configure DLP policies to block file access from specific external domains or individual users in SharePoint and OneDrive, providing granular control over sensitive content access. This feature helps prevent unintended data exposure while supporting compliance requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Posture Management – Data Security Posture Agent
updates.summary: A new intelligent agent uses natural language processing and LLMs to discover and analyze sensitive data across documents, emails, and messages, going beyond traditional keyword-based detection. This helps admins proactively identify and assess risks across their data estate.

updates.title: CVE-2026-65668: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper access control vulnerability in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Admins should apply available patches immediately to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive compliance data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Protection for External Web Search in Copilot
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches, adding another layer of data loss prevention. This feature is rolling out to help organizations prevent data leakage through AI-powered search interactions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard allows admins to monitor device health status across all managed endpoints and quickly identify devices that are not ready for policy updates. This visibility helps ensure consistent DLP enforcement across the organization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope Lifecycle Status Evaluation Control
updates.summary: Adaptive Scopes now provide explicit administrative control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, enabling more precise policy targeting. This ensures scope membership aligns with organizational changes as users' employment status or site ownership changes.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Admins can now add archiving actions to SharePoint retention policies, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while keeping it discoverable and compliant. This feature extends data lifecycle management capabilities beyond simple keep-or-delete decisions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Guided Diagnostics and Resolution Experience
updates.summary: A new guided diagnostics tool helps admins understand why DLP policies are or are not triggering as expected, showing which policies matched, evaluation order, and condition details. For E5 customers, Copilot-powered insights provide tailored recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Auto-labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Admins can now view per-policy coverage reports showing how many files have been labeled, remain unlabeled, and whether they were included in the latest simulation snapshot. This visibility helps track enforcement progress and identify gaps in auto-labeling policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP and Auto-labeling for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP and Information Protection auto-labeling now extend to non-Microsoft applications including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. Supported conditions and actions vary by application, enabling broader data protection across hybrid cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enabling enforcement of restrictive actions against untrusted cloud applications. This capability prevents sensitive data leakage through browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now combines triage agent and standard alert dashboards into a single unified alerts list, allowing analysts to manage both classic and agent-triaged alerts from one location. This simplifies alert management and improves investigator efficiency.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Expanded User Profile Details
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management alerts now display enriched user profile signals from Microsoft Entra including office location, employee type, department, and last working date. This additional context helps analysts make more informed decisions during alert triage and investigation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Expanded Notes on Alerts and Cases
updates.summary: Analysts and investigators can now add and view notes on both alerts and cases, with automatic system-generated notes for status changes, assignments, and case escalations. This improves collaboration and audit trails during investigation workflows.
